The river that runs through London is the Thames.

Regarding the cohesion of the provided text, it demonstrates strong internal coherence through effective use of transitions and linking devices. The text begins with a clear topic sentence identifying the problem (coral reefs suffering due to acidification). The second sentence uses the phrase "also to blame" to add a secondary cause (increased water temperature), creating a logical additive link. The third sentence shifts focus to the impact on fish populations using the phrase "depend on these reefs," which links back to the subject of the first sentence. Finally, the concluding sentence uses "This situation" as a demonstrative reference to summarize the preceding points, and the phrase "not only... but also" effectively expands the scope of the impact from marine life to human communities, providing a comprehensive and well-connected argument.
